title: SidecarInstallUiPackageV1Params
description: One chunk of the deployment's desktop UI package archive, relayed by the client after the sidecar's own download failed for a network, proxy or TLS reason (package 0.1.47). Every chunk but the last carries exactly 131072 bytes; chunk_count is ceil(total_bytes / 131072).

upload_id.description: Chosen by the client for one pass over one archive's bytes, the same for all its chunks; a random UUID. The sidecar assembles only one upload at a time.

digest.description: The package digest, equal to the digest the calling Origin last offered with sidecar.configure.v1.

content_base64.description: The chunk's bytes, RFC 4648 base64 with padding.
